description: viral.app tracks and analyzes UGC performance across TikTok, Instagram, YouTube, and Facebook. This plugin connects ChatGPT and Codex to your viral.app workspace: query tracked account and video analytics, build leaderboards and KPI reports, manage tracking, organize content with tags and tag workflows, read Creator Hub campaigns, and pull live platform data when you need current numbers. Sign-in runs through OAuth and is scoped to one viral.app organization; tools that spend billable credits always quote their cost first and only execute after you confirm. Requires a viral.app account with API access.

defaultPrompt: Build a weekly leaderboard of my top tracked accounts and videos by views gained
Which of my tracked accounts have stopped posting in the last 14 days?
